provenance.instrument: 2021 International Residential Code as adopted by the PA Uniform Construction Code, plus labeled planning assumptions
provenance.status_detail: PA UCC moved to the 2021 I-Codes effective Jan 1, 2026 (research notes, secondary). IRC text read on codes.iccsafe.org.
checks: This value is a building code default or a planning assumption, not the town's zoning rule
Walls under 5 ft from a lot line need a 1-hour rating. No openings under 3 ft (IRC Table R302.1(1))
An internal or attached ADU makes the house a two-family dwelling (IRC R302.3 separation)
provenance.notes: Used only for keys a place file leaves unconfirmed. The resolver marks them in 'assumed'.

path.note: No ADU rule on file for this place. Treat as not allowed until checked.

setback_side_ft.note: Building code, not zoning: a wall at 5 ft or more from the lot line needs no fire rating. Closer needs a 1-hour wall.

setback_rear_ft.note: Same building code rule as the side lot line.

setback_rear_alley_ft.section: 2021 IRC R302.1, Table R302.1(1) and R202 fire separation distance
setback_rear_alley_ft.note: R202 measures to the centerline of an alley, so this is conservative. With a wide alley the wall can sit closer.

setback_front_ft.note: Zoning sets the front setback. No building code default.

separation_ft.section: 2021 IRC R302.1, Table R302.1(1) and R202 fire separation distance
separation_ft.note: Planning default. R202 measures to an imaginary line between two buildings on the lot, and the line need not be midway. 5 ft each side gives 10 ft with no rated walls and unlimited openings. Closer is possible: a 1-hour rated wall can sit at 0 ft from the line, openings are barred under 3 ft and limited to 25% of the wall from 3 to 5 ft, and with sprinklers (Table R302.1(2)) an unrated wall with unlimited openings needs only 3 ft. R302.1 Exception 2 exempts 'walls of individual dwelling units and their accessory structures located on the same lot'. It may remove the line for a second dwelling. Ask the code official.

rated_wall_below_ft.note: Without sprinklers, a wall under 5 ft from the lot line or the line between buildings needs a 1-hour rating (exposure from both sides).

no_openings_below_ft.section: 2021 IRC R302.1, Table R302.1(1), Openings in walls
no_openings_below_ft.note: No openings under 3 ft. From 3 ft to under 5 ft, openings up to 25% of the wall area.

sprinklered_unrated_min_ft.note: With an automatic sprinkler system (P2904), an unrated wall with unlimited openings may sit at 3 ft.

max_adus.note: Most common PA approach per research notes section 3.

max_sqft.note: Varies by town. Often 800 sq ft per research notes, not used as a default.
